"""Fixture (b): f-string with field placeholders."""

from agent_workflows import artifact_meta


def _make_spec(spec_id: str, status: str) -> str:
    return (
        f"# Spec: Demo {spec_id}\n\n"
        f"- Id: {spec_id}\n"
        f"- Status: {status}\n"
    )


def test_fstring_spec_approved() -> None:
    text = _make_spec("sp2001", "approved")
    st = artifact_meta.read_text(text, record_type="spec")
    assert st.id6 == "sp2001"
    assert st.status == "approved"


def test_fstring_spec_draft() -> None:
    text = _make_spec("sp2002", "draft")
    st = artifact_meta.read_text(text, record_type="spec")
    assert st.id6 == "sp2002"
    assert st.status == "draft"
